overview: A self-managing, icon-only participants control button for Zoom Video SDK sessions. It displays a fixed Participants icon with a numeric badge showing the live participant count (remote users + self), registers as a delegate observer to keep the badge synchronized with user join/leave and session lifecycle events, and on tap toggles a bottom-sheet participants panel. The panel offers per-participant moderation actions (mute/unmute, make host, make co-host, rename, remove) and host-only bottom buttons (Mute all, Ask all to unmute).

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitIconBtn
typeDefinitions.notes: UIButton subclass providing icon/badge/layout configuration and click callback dispatch. Exposes @objc badge properties used by this button: showBadge, badgeText, showBadgeBackground, badgeTextColor, badgeBackgroundColor, badgeWidth.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolKitManager
typeDefinitions.role: holds ZoomVideoSDK instance and videoSDKDelegate fan-out; audio/user helpers accessed via videoSDK?.getAudioHelper()/getUserHelper()

typeDefinitions.name: CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate
typeDefinitions.role: weak fan-out delegate; register via add(_:) / remove(_:)

typeDefinitions.name: BottomPanelPresenter
typeDefinitions.role: presents/dismisses a bottom-sheet panel modally over UIApplication.topViewController() on the main queue; isPresented reflects current presentation state

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitParticipantsPanel
typeDefinitions.role: bottom-sheet participant list with search; self-registers as SDK observer while visible (observeSDKEvents); surfaces onParticipantTapped and setButtons(_:)

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitParticipant
typeDefinitions.notes: Snapshot built from a ZoomVideoSDKUser at list-build time.

typeDefinitions.name: CustomActionSheet
typeDefinitions.role: presents a titled action sheet of CustomActionSheet.Action items from the top view controller; only shown if at least one action is available

typeDefinitions.name: ZMToastManager
typeDefinitions.notes: Non-blocking toasts shown by Mute all / Ask all to unmute.

typeDefinitions.name: ZoomVideoSDKUser
typeDefinitions.notes: Local user via getSession()?.getMySelf(); remotes via getRemoteUsers().

prerequisites: Zoom Video SDK initialized and registered with the toolkit via ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize(videoSDK:bundleId:) BEFORE constructing the button.
Construct and use on the main thread (@MainActor).
lifecycle.ifNotInitialized: If ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK is nil or there is no active session, refreshParticipantBadge() hides the badge (showBadge = false, badgeText = nil). A tap still presents an (empty) panel; createParticipantsPanel/refreshList produce no participants because getSession() is nil.

actions: build descriptor (40x40, clear bg, secondaryLabel icon color, zero padding, icon 'Participants')

lifecycle.badgeRefresh: The badge refreshes at construction and on the listed delegate events (session join/leave, user join/leave).
lifecycle.delegateModel: The button does NOT assign itself to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate. It registers with the toolkit fan-out delegate ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate (CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate), enabling multiple observers. Child delegates are stored weakly. The presented ZMUIToolkitParticipantsPanel independently registers/unregisters with the same fan-out delegate while visible.

states.note: This button has no enumerated icon-state machine. Observable runtime state is the badge value and whether the panel is presented.

logic: if session == nil -> showBadge = false; badgeText = nil; return
if participantCount > 0 -> badgeText = String(participantCount); showBadge = true

stateTransitions.effect: badge recomputed once the SDK roster reflects the change
badge recomputed once the SDK roster reflects the change

behaviorNotes: Host/manager actions are determined from the local user's role when the panel is opened (from getMySelf()?.isHost()/isManager()). To reflect a role change, re-open the panel to recompute available actions.

apis.name: init
apis.description: Builds the panel-toggle tap callback, constructs the icon button (40x40, clear bg, secondaryLabel icon color, zero padding, 'Participants' icon), configures a borderless badge with secondaryLabel text color, registers as a delegate observer, and computes the initial badge count.

apis.name: init(coder:)
apis.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Calls fatalError. Do not instantiate from Storyboard/XIB.

apis.name: tap (panel toggle)
apis.description: On tap, toggles the participants panel: if presenter.isPresented it dismisses; otherwise it presents a freshly created ZMUIToolkitParticipantsPanel. Presentation/dismissal is dispatched to the main queue by BottomPanelPresenter and shown modally over UIApplication.topViewController().
sideEffects: Presents or dismisses a modal bottom-sheet panel

apis.name: refreshParticipantBadge
apis.description: Recomputes the participant count (remote users + self) from the SDK session and updates showBadge / badgeText. Called from init, onSessionJoin, onSessionLeave, onUserJoin, onUserLeave. Documented for completeness.
sideEffects: Sets showBadge and badgeText (hides badge when no session or count == 0)

apis.name: createParticipantsPanel
apis.description: Builds a ZMUIToolkitParticipantsPanel (cellStyle .full, selectionMode .tapAction, observeSDKEvents true, showSearchBar true), wires onParticipantTapped to present a per-participant action sheet, and if the local user isHost() attaches host-only bottom buttons: 'Mute all' (muteAllAudio(false) + 'All muted' toast) and 'Ask all to unmute' (unmuteAllAudio() + 'Request sent' toast).
sideEffects: Creates a panel view and (for hosts) registers two bottom buttons with optimistic toasts

inheritedBadgeConfiguration.warning: badgeText/showBadge are driven automatically by refreshParticipantBadge(); manual writes are overwritten on the next roster/lifecycle callback. Visual-only properties (badgeTextColor, badgeBackgroundColor, showBadgeBackground, badgeWidth) are safe to customize.

perParticipantActionSheet.presentedWhen: panel.onParticipantTapped fires (a participant row is tapped)

visibilityRules.calls: userHelper.changeName(newName, with: user) via rename alert

notes: Action sheet is presented when at least one action is available (actions array non-empty).
Most actions call panel.refreshList() after invocation to update the row state.
Roles are determined from getMySelf()?.isHost()/isManager() when the panel is opened.

hostBottomButtons.shownWhen: getMySelf()?.isHost() == true (determined when the panel is opened)

callbacks.name: onSessionJoin
callbacks.description: Fired when the local user joins the session. Refreshes the participant-count badge.

callbacks.name: onSessionLeave
callbacks.description: Fired when the local user leaves/ends the session. Refreshes the badge (typically hides it because getSession() is no longer valid or the count becomes 0).

callbacks.name: onUserJoin
callbacks.signature: public func onUserJoin(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKUserHelper?, users: [ZoomVideoSDKUser]?)
callbacks.description: Fired when one or more users join. Refreshes the participant-count badge once the SDK roster reflects the change.

callbacks.name: onUserLeave
callbacks.signature: public func onUserLeave(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKUserHelper?, users: [ZoomVideoSDKUser]?)
callbacks.description: Fired when one or more users leave. Refreshes the participant-count badge once the SDK roster reflects the change.

moderationActions.strategy: Moderation actions are issued to the SDK from the panel. To respond to outcomes, observe SDK events via ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).
moderationActions.targetResolution: Each action resolves the target user via findUser(for:) (matches getMySelf() then getRemoteUsers() by getID()) and fetches the relevant helper from ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK. If either is unavailable, the action does not run. commitRename applies only when the new name is non-empty and changed.
observingOutcomes: To respond to outcomes, register your own ZoomVideoSDKDelegate via ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:) and observe onError(_:detail:) and relevant status callbacks (e.g. onUserHostChanged).

required: Initialize the toolkit (ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize) before constructing the button for a correct badge count and functional panel/actions.
Construct and use the button on the main thread.
forbidden: Instantiating via init?(coder:) / Interface Builder (traps with fatalError).
Assigning the button (or anything) directly to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate; use ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).
Manually setting badgeText/showBadge to represent the count; they are driven by refreshParticipantBadge() and overwritten on the next roster/lifecycle callback.
notes: Visual-only badge properties (badgeTextColor, badgeBackgroundColor, showBadgeBackground, badgeWidth) are safe to customize.
Host/manager actions are determined from the local user's role when the panel is opened. To reflect a role change, re-open the panel to recompute available actions.
